## Behavior and scope

Describe the user task, the resulting behavior, and the affected client/admin/receptionist/developer screens.

## Design and code review

- [ ] Read AGENTS.md and docs/design-standard.md; reused tokens and shared patterns.
- [ ] Checked desktop, 320px mobile, keyboard/focus, zoom, and reduced motion.
- [ ] Checked loading, empty, error, disabled, and success states where affected.
- [ ] No new exceptions, inaccessible color pairs, or hidden essential content.
- [ ] Preserved folder and server/client dependency boundaries.
- [ ] Ran npm run verify and recorded actual results below.
- [ ] Recorded review limitations and sent a verified design handoff to every affected admin, client, receptionist, or developer work chat.

## Validation

Commands/results, tested routes and viewport sizes, screenshots, and remaining concerns.
